article.summary_es: MUNA Social Services es una despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad. Abre los lunes de 5pm a 6pm, solo el segundo y cuarto lunes del mes.
article.summary_en: MUNA Social Services is a food pantry in Brooklyn, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. It is open Mondays 5pm-6pm, on the 2nd and 4th Monday only.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos incluida en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 167 East 43rd St, Brooklyn, NY 11203.
Abre los lunes de 5pm a 6pm, solo el segundo y cuarto lunes del mes.
Puede llamar al (212) 920-6202 para preguntar antes de ir.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si pide algún requisito.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 167 East 43rd St, Brooklyn, NY 11203.
It is open Mondays 5pm-6pm, on the 2nd and 4th Monday of the month only.
You can call (212) 920-6202 to ask questions before visiting.
The listing does not say what food is given or if there are any requirements.
